blocks.x: Start with who you want to bring to Australia, then pick the group below. If you are not sure where you fit, [book a consultation](/book-an-appointment). A registered agent will tell you which options exist, and which do not.

**Government charges.** Home Affairs sets these and changes them, usually each 1 July. A partner visa is one of the most expensive visas to lodge. Check the Department of Home Affairs website for the current charge.

**Other costs.** Budget for health examinations, police certificates, document translations and, for parent visas, private health insurance and the Assurance of Support. Our professional fees are separate and set out in a written agreement.
**Waiting times.** A partner visa decision commonly takes more than a year. Parent visas vary from a few months (870) to many years (103 and 804).
For the two-instalment parent visas, see our [cost for contributory visas page](/family-visa/cost-for-contributory-visas).

A partner visa has two stages. You apply once and pay once. First you receive a temporary visa. About two years after you applied, you provide updated evidence for the permanent visa. The deciding question is where the applicant is when you lodge.

add.h2: Parent visas: which one is right for me?

blocks.x: Australia caps the number of parent visas each year. That is why parent visas cost more, wait longer, or both. All permanent parent visas must pass the **Balance of Family test**: at least half of the parent's children must live permanently in Australia, or more of them than in any other single country.
